title: What's a normal week like for you these days?

read.intro: First, a chat. An old school friend finds Nina online after many years. What do you think the friend asks? Guess, then tap to see the message.
read.hidden: Nina?? Is that you? 😄 Long time no see! What have you been up to? What's a normal week like for you these days?
read.reply: Ha, **it's been ages**! **Last I heard**, you were in Singapore — are you still there? As for me, life's **pretty much the same**: same job, same apartment. I work from home three days a week. **Don't get me wrong**, I love it, but by day three I'm talking to my plants 😄 So on those days I make myself **get out of the house** first thing — a walk by the river, **come rain or shine**. Evenings? **You name it**: a cooking class, my sister's kids, TV shows (I **rely on** Netflix **way more than I should** 😅). And on Thursdays there's a quiz night at our local bar. **I can't explain it, but** our silly little team **makes me feel part of something**. (We've never won. Not once.) What about you? **What have you been up to?**

task: Now it's your turn. An old friend from school or university finds you online and sends you the same message: “Long time no see! What have you been up to? What's a normal week like for you these days?” Write your reply — or record it as a voice message.

items: I've been meaning to get in touch for ages!
I thought you were still in …!
Last I heard, you were in … — are you still there?
I make myself get out of the house …, come rain or shine.
I've got more time on my hands these days.
I'm not bored at all — quite the contrary!
I rely on … way more than I should. 😅
I can't explain it, but … makes me feel part of something.
Don't get me wrong, I love …, but …
What have you been up to?

plan_instr: Tap the phrases you'd like to use.
produce_instr: Write your reply to your friend. (Prefer to talk? Tap Record it.)
